observed_documents.title: Subways resume after debris sparks track fire under Grand Central Terminal
observed_documents.text:
# Subways resume after debris sparks track fire under Grand Central Terminal

NEW YORK -- Debris caught fire overnight in a subway tunnel under Grand Central Terminal, causing delays for the morning commute.

The MTA says 4/6 train service has since been restored between 86th and Wall Street.

Riders should still expect delays and service changes through the area.

CBS New York's Elijah Westbrook reported dozens of MTA crew members and firefighters could be seen walking down the platform and into the southbound tunnel between 42nd and 33rd streets.

Smoke filled the tunnel and halted service overnight along the Lexington Avenue line.

Riders that Westbrook spoke with raised concerns about debris on the tracks.

"You look into the tracks, it's cluttered with filth and garbage. There's no reason for it, there's cans all over the place. Stuff like that is going to create a problem," one man said.

"Doesn't affect my ridership. It's in God's hands, so take it from there," said another.

No injuries were reported, and service was restored around 5:30 a.m.

observed_documents.title: MTA: Manhattan-bound 7 train from Queens hits debris, stalls for 2 hours
observed_documents.text:
# MTA: Manhattan-bound 7 train from Queens hits debris, stalls for 2 hours

NEW YORK -- Hundreds of subway riders were rescued Sunday after the FDNY says their train ran over debris, stranding them for hours.

The incident happened at around 5:30 p.m. on Sunday as a 7 train was in a tunnel approaching Grand Central Terminal. The FDNY said about 750 people were on board, adding some of the cars became smoky.

CBS2 saw people getting off at the Vernon Boulevard-Jackson Avenue station in Queens after an emergency train eventually came.

"The train stopped and all of a sudden the emergency brakes ... I was in the back car of the train and then the next thing we see is another train pulling up behind us and they send us all the way back to Queens," one passenger said.

The MTA said 7 trains are still running, but with major delays in both directions.

CBS New York Team

observed_documents.text:
# Top các cổ phiếu hàng đầu trên sàn chứng khoán Mỹ Nasdaq?

Nasdaq là một trong những chỉ số chứng khoán thế giới hàng đầu tại Hoa Kỳ.
...
Các công ty công nghệ chiếm vị trí chủ đạo trên sàn giao dịch Nasdaq, với 5 công ty hàng đầu nằm trong Magnificent 7 - nhóm 7 công ty công nghệ lớn nhất của Mỹ. Nhóm này có tổng giá trị vốn hóa lên tới gần 12 nghìn tỷ USD, tương đương với khoảng 25% tổng giá trị vốn hóa của thị trường chứng khoán Mỹ năm 2023, ước tính khoảng 49 nghìn tỷ USD.

Top các cổ phiếu hàng đầu trên sàn chứng khoán Mỹ Nasdaq (Nguồn: VTC News)

Cụ thể, tính đến thời điểm ngày 12/03/2024, top 5 cổ phiếu hàng đầu trên sàn chứng khoán Mỹ - sàn Nasdaq bao gồm: Microsoft (3,1 nghìn tỷ USD), Apple (2,7 nghìn tỷ USD), NVIDIA (2,3 nghìn tỷ USD), Amazon (1,8 nghìn tỷ USD) và Alphabet (1,7 nghìn tỷ USD).

Nhìn chung, các công ty này không chỉ “thống trị” Nasdaq mà còn là những công ty công nghệ có sức ảnh hưởng lớn nhất đến diễn biến chung của thị trường chứng khoán Mỹ. Sự thống lĩnh của nhóm Magnificent 7 nói chung và top 5 cổ phiếu trên sàn Nasdaq nói riêng phản ánh xu hướng độc quyền của các "ông lớn" công nghệ trên thị trường.

It continues to be busy at the Tule Lake Unit! Lots of new projects were started in 2013, and we welcomed over 3,500 visitors to the site.  

One of our primary projects in 2013 was meeting with you, the public, to discuss the long- term future of Tule Lake. During these meetings park staff enjoyed connecting with over 500 attendees and learned a great deal from the many perspectives and experiences shared during the meetings.  

In 2013 NPS staff completed a five year strategic plan, which set priorities for the Tule Lake Unit over the next 5 years. The plan provided us with much needed guidance while the long- term management plan is being prepared. Over the next five years, we will focus on working collaboratively with partners, collecting oral histories, gathering data on resources to inform decisions, and stabilizing historic structures and resources so that they do not degrade. We will also provide basic visitor services so that Tule Lake's history is shared with the visiting public.

observed_documents.text:
In the 1990s, peregrine falcons were beginning to rebound, and in the summer of 2001, the Peregrine Falcon Restoration Project began. # Surge in Green support in Calderdale

Support for Green Party candidates in Calderdale soared to its highest level ever in the 2024 Local Council elections, with the sharp rise in support in Halifax making the Green Party the third largest party by vote share in Calderdale.

Elaine Hay secured Northowram and Shelf with 68% of the vote to give Northowram and Shelf its third Green Councillor while Sabir Hussain gained over 25% of the vote in Park at his first attempt.

Other notable results were in Elland, Brighouse, Todmorden, Skircoat, Calder, Town and Sowerby Bridge while vote share exceeded 6% in all other wards.

observed_documents.title: Briefing: The Forced Marriage Unit's 2023 Statistics
observed_documents.text:
The Marriage and Civil Partnership (Minimum Age) Act 2022v changed the law about FM from 27 February 2023.  

According to UK law, "a forced marriage is one where one or both people do not or cannot consent to the marriage and pressure or abuse is used to force them into the marriage."vii Since February 2023, in England and Wales, it is also "when anything is done to make someone marry before they turn 18, even if there is no pressure or abuse". In Scotland, people aged 16- 18 can still marry, and in Northern Ireland they can marry so long as they have their parents' or guardians' consent.   

The kind of pressure brought to bear on people to force them to marry may include: physical (e.g. threats, violence and/or sexual violence); emotional and psychological (e.g. making someone feel like they are bringing "shame" on their family); and/or financial (e.g. taking someone's wages).vii FM is a recognised human rights abuse, and a form of both Honour- Based Abuse (HBA) and Domestic Abuse. In some jurisdictions, and by the International Labour Organization (ILO), it is also recognised as a form of modern slavery and/or human trafficking.

The rate of increase in life expectancy in LICs over the past 15 years has exceeded the rate of growth observed for life expectancy in the countries with the highest life expectancies. Longer life expectancies and population aging have resulted in an increased focus on NCDs and their risk factors in LMICs and in HICs. Three-quarters of NCD-related deaths occurred in LMICs in 2015.

# WHO发布2025世界卫生统计报告（全文下载）

2025年5月15日，世界卫生组织（WHO）官网发布了《2025世界卫生统计报告》（World Health Statistics 2025）。
...
** 2020年，全球出生时预期寿命 **下降了0.7年** ，降至72.5岁（回到2016年的水平），2021年进一步下降1.1年，降至71.4岁（回到2012年的水平）。
...
二、非传染性慢病所致死亡

2021年，全球范围内约有 **1800万70岁以下的人** 死于NCD，占该年龄段死亡人数的一半以上。NCD早逝风险特指30-70岁人群死于四大主要NCD **（心血管疾病、癌症、糖尿病、慢性呼吸系统疾病）** 的概率。统计结果显示，世界和任何地区都无法实现到2030年将过早NCD死亡风险降低三分之一的目标。自2000年以来，东南亚地区的过早NCD死亡率一直居高不下，最有可能未能达到这一目标。
...
**吸烟：** 2022年数据显示，全球≥15岁的吸烟人数达12.5亿，年龄标化吸烟率为20.9%，较2010年的26.4%基准水平实现21%的相对降幅。全球范围内，男性吸烟率仍显著高于女性。2022年数据显示：15岁及以上男性吸烟者数量是女性的4倍；2010-2022年间女性吸烟率下降34%，同期男性吸烟率仅下降17%。

# Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)

Renewable energy consumption as a percentage of total final energy consumption measures the share of energy derived from renewable sources—such as hydropower, wind, solar, and biofuels—in a country's total energy use. It reflects the transition toward cleaner energy systems and is reported annually for global comparison.

## How to read it · Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)

Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption) measures the proportion of a country's total final energy use that comes from renewable sources, including hydropower, wind, solar, geothermal, and modern biofuels. This indicator is expressed as a percentage and is reported annually, providing a standardized way to track the adoption of renewable energy across different economies.

A higher percentage indicates a greater reliance on renewable sources in meeting energy needs, which is often associated with lower greenhouse gas emissions and reduced dependence on fossil fuels. Users should interpret this value as a snapshot of the energy mix at the point of final consumption, not as a measure of total energy production or primary energy supply.

- South Sudan – 4.65 percent
- Niger – 3.66 percent
- Angola – 3.33 percent
- Benin – 3.29 percent
- Equatorial Guinea – 3.23 percent
- Uganda – 3.18 percent
- Democratic Republic of the Congo – 3.11 percent
- Chad – 3.01 percent
- Mali – 2.9 percent
- Zambia – 2.83 percent

The top 10 is completely dominated by African countries, which reflects a trend seen across the continent; according to the International Monetary Fund (IMF), Africa’s population has increased tenfold since 1900, attributed primarily to dropping mortality rates and increasingly high birth rates.
